newsitem.title: USA: N.J. hospital studies merger with JFK -- paper.
newsitem.headline: N.J. hospital studies merger with JFK -- paper.

text.p: Muhlenberg Regional Medical Center in Plainfield, N.J., has decided to explore the possibility of merging with JFK Medical Center in Edison, the Star-Ledger reported Wednesday.
A combined operation would create a system with 837 acute care beds, 644 long-term beds, a 5,600-employee staff, and 1,100 physicians.
The boards of both JFK and Muhlenberg have approved a letter of agreement to study a merger, which could take about three to six months, the paper said.
